title: Television: James Paul McCartney | 1973
content:
Filming for the television special James Paul McCartney continued on 20 March 1973.

On this day Wings mimed to an audio recording of ‘Mary Had A Little Lamb’ made at Elstree earlier in the month.

The male members of the band wore matching white suits, and Linda McCartney wore a long dress and hat. The shoot took place on Hampstead Heath in London, and included scenes of them rowing on a lake.
